full.notes: Input as in the authors' evaluation: greyscale page turned into RGB, luma DCT numbers clipped to 0..20, 8x8 quantisation table. PNG pages are re-saved as JPEG quality 100 just before reading (after padding for full); JPEG pages keep their own DCT numbers and table unless the table has a value above 63 (then they are re-saved too, PLAN CHANGE); shrink512 pages are always re-saved. full = 512x512 tiles from (0,0), no overlap, white padding right/bottom, joined back, padding cropped. shrink512 = longest side 512 (cv2 INTER_AREA), padded white to 512x512, map resized back with bilinear interpolation.
full.value_scale: softmax probability of tampered, float32 (not rounded to 8 bit)
